title: 第11章 凡人极限与等级锁第12章 经验底蕴与佛门神功
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
一号死矿洞深处，黑暗犹如实质般粘稠。
空气中弥漫着高浓度的硫磺毒气，如果不戴防毒面罩，普通矿工在这里撑不过半个时辰就会肺部溃烂而死。
苏寒像一只融于暗夜的壁虎，贴着冰冷潮湿的岩壁无声潜行。
他的每一步都经过极其严密的计算。脚尖先落地，试探岩层的稳定性，确认没有松动的碎石和隐藏的地刺陷阱后，才会将身体的重心缓缓移交过去。
“滴答……滴答……”
地下水滴落的微弱声响，在10点精神力的恐怖感知下，如同雷鸣般清晰。
苏寒的脑海中，那张羊皮地图的路线如同全息投影般展开。
他已经深入矿洞两千米。偏离了主干道，正在向第一个标着“红色交叉”的极度危险区域逼近。薛凶死前频频回头的方向，正是这里。
突然，苏寒的脚步一顿。
他敏锐地察觉到，前方拐角处的空气流速发生了极其微弱的改变。伴随而来的，是一股令人作呕的、比硫磺还要刺鼻的腥臭味。
有活物。
苏寒没有探头去看。他悄无声息地向后退了三步，将身体彻底隐没在一块巨大的钟乳石后方。
他缓缓蹲下身，从地上摸起一块拳头大小的赤铁矿石。手腕发力，12点力量精准控制着矿石的抛物线。
“嗖——”
矿石越过拐角，砸在前方十几米外的积水坑里，发出一声清脆的“吧嗒”声。
几乎在声音响起的同一瞬间。
“嘶嘶——！”
一阵令人头皮发麻的密集摩擦声从暗处爆起。
借着矿石砸出的微弱水花反光，苏寒看清了那东西的轮廓。那是一只体长超过一米、浑身覆盖着暗红色铁甲的巨型变异多足虫！它的口器犹如两把交错的生锈剪刀，正疯狂地撕咬着那块被苏寒扔出去的石头，瞬间将坚硬的赤铁矿咬成了一堆粉末。
【异化铁甲蜈蚣（地下低级妖兽）】

“防御极高，咬合力惊人。但视力退化，全靠声音和气味感知猎物。”
苏寒在心底瞬间得出了敌方的数据模型。
硬刚？不存在的。在这漆黑的地下，与一只满身毒刺的变异妖兽近身肉搏，是最愚蠢的送死行为。就算赢了，只要被擦破一点皮，未知的毒素也会要了他的命。
苏寒的目光迅速扫过周围的地形。
他头顶正上方，有一块重达数百斤、边缘已经严重风化开裂的悬空岩石。
苏寒无声地冷笑。
他双手握紧精钢鹤嘴镐的木柄，身体微微下蹲，如同蓄势待发的猎豹。随后，他从腰间摸出第二块石头，狠狠砸向自己正前方的地面。
“砰！”
巨大的声响瞬间吸引了异化铁甲蜈蚣的注意。
“嘶嘶！”蜈蚣发出尖锐的嘶鸣，百足齐动，化作一道暗红色的残影，贴着地面疯狂向苏寒藏身的位置扑来。
十米。五米。三米。
就在蜈蚣即将冲入钟乳石后方、张开那对恐怖口器的瞬间！
苏寒动了。
他没有后退，反而双腿猛然发力，整个人犹如炮弹般贴着地面向前滑铲，险之又险地从蜈蚣的腹部下方滑过。
在交错而过的刹那，他手中的精钢鹤嘴镐自下而上，带着12点力量的恐怖爆发，狠狠凿击在那块摇摇欲坠的悬空岩石根部！
“咔嚓——轰隆！”
震耳欲聋的巨响。
数百斤重的巨岩被苏寒一镐砸断了最后的连接点，裹挟着万钧之势，轰然砸落！
异化铁甲蜈蚣根本来不及反应，它庞大的身躯正好处在巨岩坠落的正下方。
“噗嗤！”

绿色的腥臭体液如同喷泉般溅射而出。巨岩精准无误地将铁甲蜈蚣拦腰砸成了两段！坚硬的铁甲在数百斤的重压下如同纸糊般碎裂。蜈蚣的上半截身子在地上疯狂扭动、挣扎，口器胡乱地撕咬着空气。
苏寒早在巨岩落下的瞬间，就已经施展翻滚动作，退到了十米之外的安全距离。
他冷漠地看着在巨岩下垂死的妖兽，没有上前补刀，绝不靠近垂死挣扎的毒物。他就这么静静地站着，看着它流干最后一滴绿血。
content_en:
Deep in Dead Mine No. 1, the darkness is as thick as substance.
The air is filled with high concentrations of sulfur gas. Without a gas mask, an ordinary miner would die from lung ulceration in less than half an hour.
Su Han was like a gecko melting into the dark night, sneaking silently against the cold and damp rock wall.
Every step he takes is extremely carefully calculated. Land on your toes first, test the stability of the rock formation, and confirm that there are no loose gravels or hidden ground thorn traps before slowly transferring your body's center of gravity to it.
"Tick tock...tick tock..."
The faint sound of dripping underground water was as clear as thunder under the terrifying perception of 10 points of mental power.
In Su Han's mind, the route of the sheepskin map unfolded like a holographic projection.
He has gone two thousand meters into the mine. We have deviated from the main road and are approaching the first extremely dangerous area marked "Red Cross". This is the direction that Xue Ji turned back to before he died.
Suddenly, Su Han's footsteps stopped.
He was keenly aware that the air velocity at the corner ahead had changed extremely slightly. What followed was a disgusting stench that was more pungent than sulfur.
There are living things.
Su Han didn't look around. He silently took three steps back, completely hiding his body behind a huge stalactite.
He slowly squatted down and picked up a fist-sized piece of hematite ore from the ground. Use your wrist to exert force, and 12 points of power accurately control the parabola of the ore.
"Whoosh——"
The ore crossed the corner and hit the puddle more than ten meters in front, making a crisp "click" sound.
Almost at the same moment the sound sounded.
"Hiss—!"
A numbing sound of intense friction erupted from the darkness.
Su Han could clearly see the outline of the thing through the reflection of the weak water splashed by the ore. It was a giant mutated multi-legged insect with a body length of more than one meter and covered with dark red iron armor! Its mouthparts were like two intertwined rusty scissors, frantically biting the stone thrown by Su Han, instantly biting the hard hematite into a pile of powder.
[Alienated Iron-armored Centipede (Underground Low-Level Demonic Beast)]
"The defense is extremely high and the bite force is amazing. However, its eyesight has deteriorated and it relies entirely on sound and smell to detect prey."
Su Han instantly figured out the enemy's data model in his heart.
Tough? Doesn't exist. In this dark underground, fighting in close combat with a mutated monster covered in venomous stings is the most stupid way to commit suicide. Even if he wins, as long as his skin is scratched, unknown toxins will kill him.
Su Han's eyes quickly scanned the surrounding terrain.
Directly above his head, there was a hanging rock weighing several hundred kilograms, with severely weathered and cracked edges.
Su Han sneered silently.
He grasped the wooden handle of the stainless steel pickaxe with both hands and squatted down slightly, like a cheetah ready to attack. Then, he took out a second stone from his waist and smashed it against the ground directly in front of him.
"Bang!"
The huge sound instantly attracted the attention of the alienated armored centipede.
"Hiss!" The centipede let out a sharp hiss, and all its legs moved together, turning into a dark red afterimage and rushing towards Su Han's hiding place against the ground.
Ten meters. five meters. Three meters.
Just when the centipede is about to rush behind the stalactite and open its terrifying mouthparts!
Su Han moved.
Instead of retreating, his legs suddenly exerted force, and his whole body slid forward like a cannonball against the ground, slipping under the centipede's abdomen with dangerous risks.
At the moment when they passed each other, the stainless steel pickaxe in his hand went up from bottom to top, with a terrifying explosion of 12 points of power, and struck hard at the root of the crumbling suspended rock!
“Crack—boom!”
A deafening bang.
The giant rock weighing hundreds of kilograms was smashed by Su Han at the last connection point with a pickaxe, and it crashed down with a huge force!
The alienated iron-armored centipede had no time to react. It was huge.The large body was just below the huge rock fall.
"Pfft!"
Green fishy bodily fluids sputtered out like a fountain. The giant rock accurately smashed the armored centipede into two pieces! The hard iron armor shattered like paper under the weight of hundreds of kilograms. The centipede's upper body twisted and struggled wildly on the ground, its mouthparts biting the air randomly.
As soon as the giant rock fell, Su Han had already performed a rolling action and retreated to a safe distance ten meters away.
He looked at the dying monster under the giant rock indifferently. He did not step forward to touch it, and never got close to the dying creature. He just stood there quietly, watching it drain out the last drop of green blood.
